texts.What AI-native products / systems have y: A production multi-machine Claude agent fleet (6 machines) that I run in public: cross-machine consensus, an AI-native CRM, persistent memory, and 100+ automation routines. Published pieces: claw-consensus (reproducible multi-machine agent consensus with offline demo and published evals) and verbatim-citation-gate (a zero-token gate plus a burden-of-proof judge that catches fabricated RAG citations, MIT). Earlier I rebuilt my own CRM into an AI-native system - social enrichment, parsing at scale, lead-to-call pipelines - used daily by up to 30 operators. I also published measured agent-fleet reliability evals (07.2026): 0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs. 110 public repos at github.com/tonydzi.
